letters.title: you miss me
letters.text:
My Asechka,

If you opened this because you miss me, I miss you too. I wish I could be beside you right now, with your arm wrapped around mine.

Until I can, text me whatever’s on your mind. The random thought, the tiny detail, all of it. I love hearing from you.

You make me feel seen in so many little ways. I hope this makes you feel a little closer to me.

I love you.
me ♡

letters.title: you’re sad
letters.text:
My love,

You don’t have to act okay with me. If you want to talk, I’ll listen. If you’d rather be quiet, we can be quiet together.

You notice so many little things about me. I want you to feel just as seen and cared for, especially on the days that feel heavy.

I love you, Asechka. A difficult day doesn’t change that.

me ♡

letters.title: you can’t sleep
letters.text:
Asechka,

If your thoughts are keeping you company tonight, here’s one more: there’s someone who feels lucky to love you.

Nothing needs to be figured out all at once. Save a little room for tomorrow. I’m looking forward to another day of your messages, your sense of humor, and all those tiny things that make you you.

Goodnight, my love. I hope the next thing you drift into is a lovely dream.

me ♡

letters.title: you need encouragement
letters.text:
My Asechka,

I love how smart, caring, and responsible you are. I see those things in you even when you’re nervous or doubting yourself.

You don’t have to get everything right to make me proud. Try the next little step, and tell me how it goes. I want to hear about the things you’re excited about, and the ones that take a little courage.

I’m rooting for you.

me ♡

letters.title: you feel overwhelmed
letters.text:
My love,

You care about so much, and I know that can be tiring. For a minute, put down whatever can wait. Relax your shoulders. Have some water. You’re allowed a little break.

If talking would help, send me the messy version. You don’t have to put everything into the right words first. We can think about one thing at a time.

I wish I could offer you my arm right now. For now, this is a little reminder that I’m here to listen.

me ♡

letters.title: you’re doubting yourself
letters.text:
Asechka,

You believe in me in all kinds of circumstances. Let me return a little of that belief.

I see how much thought you put into things. I see how smart you are, how responsible you are, and how you care even about the details other people might miss. One mistake or one uncertain day doesn’t erase any of that.

You can try, change your mind, learn, and try again. I love you through all of those parts.

me ♡

letters.title: you need a smile
letters.text:
My Asechka,

Imagine me trying very hard to write something smooth here, knowing you’d probably find a way to make fun of it. And then I’d laugh too, because somehow our brains find the same things funny.

That’s one of my favorite things about you. I can be a little ridiculous with you and feel understood.

Send me the most random thought you’ve had today. I want to hear it. Also, yes, I’m smiling while thinking about you. You can take credit for that.

me ♡

letters.title: we’ve had a disagreement
letters.text:
My love,

If we’re upset with each other, I still care about how you feel. I want to understand what hurt, including anything I need to take responsibility for.

We can take a little time to cool down, then talk when we’re ready. You deserve to be heard without having to rush past your feelings.

I love being close to you. I want us to be able to say the difficult things too, kindly and honestly, and listen to each other properly.

me ♡

letters.title: you have something to celebrate
letters.text:
Asechka!!

Okay, tell me everything. What happened? How did it feel? What was the first thing you thought? I want all the little details.

Whether it’s something huge or a small thing that took courage, I’m happy you have a reason to feel proud today. Let yourself enjoy it for a bit before thinking about whatever comes next.

If I were there, this is where I’d be looking at you with the biggest smile. I love getting to cheer for you.

me ♡

letters.title: you’re thinking about tomorrow
letters.text:
My Asechka,

When I think about what’s ahead, I think about little things I want to do with you. More pictures to keep here. More songs that remind us of each other. Somewhere new to go, with your arm around mine.

We don’t have to plan every part right now. I’m happy we get to find out more about each other as we go.

If something about tomorrow is worrying you, tell me. And if you’re dreaming about something lovely, I’d really like to hear that too.

me ♡

letters.title: it’s just an ordinary day
letters.text:
My love,

Nothing special has to happen for me to want to hear from you. Tell me what you ate, what annoyed you, the tiny thing you noticed, or the song you’ve had stuck in your head.

I love how you remember the small details about me. It makes even an ordinary conversation feel like someone is really paying attention. I want to know your little details too.

So this letter is for a completely normal day, just to say I’m glad you’re in mine.

me ♡

letters.title: you need a little extra love
letters.text:
My Asechka,

I love your gorgeous eyes, and the way you look away when someone compliments you. I love your sense of humor, your caring heart, and how you make me feel seen.

I love that you believe in me. I love the little ways you reassure me and remember what matters to me. You give me so many reasons to feel lucky.

If you wanted a little extra love today, here it is. I’m thinking about you, smiling at those little details, and wishing I could tell you this in person.

me ♡

things.text: I love the way you look away when someone compliments you.
How you fidget when you’re nervous.
How your lips js lay on top of each other.
How I can see my reflection in your gorgeous eyes.
How you’re loving, caring, responsible, smart and care about me.
How you care to remember the small details.
How you make me feel seen and care about all the small details.
How you wrap your arm around mine.
How you start texting a lil off when you’re tired or annoyed.
How your eyes change color depending on your mood.
How you appreciate the tiny stuff that are bare minimum.
How you assure me how much you love me.
How unlustful and loyal you are.
How your sense of humor is the same as mine.
How somehow someway you’re always connected with me.
How you know what I am thinking about.
How you know when to perfectly text me.
How you believe in me in all cases and circumstances.
